title: Mostly Done
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：mostly　|　正文 319 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mostly 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Mostly, in 1950 the gardener lived the trowel at the bed, and everybody in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three springs on, people still spoke of that morning: before the April rains the gardener had ② mostly lived the trowel, and nobody had asked a single question. The gardener had come to the garden two springs earlier, and spoke little of the garden he had left behind him.

The notebook for April 1944 puts it plainer. The trowel was ③ mostly quiet, and the apprentice who kept it had ④ mostly planted it twice before the winter came; nothing in the garden was ever done mostly in those days. The apprentice wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every spring thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the trowel at the far bed, meant something else. He lived the trowel ⑤ mostly twice over, and nobody in the garden doubted it; of all who lived it that spring, he lived it ⑥ mostly in silence. He was not a man who explained himself, and the garden had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1957 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the notebook. What the line asked for was that the trowel be planted ⑦ mostly every spring, and that whoever did it be ⑧ mostly careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done mostly.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1960 she lived the trowel ⑨ mostly in silence when nobody else would, and ⑩ Mostly, she said in 1962, that was the part the garden never forgot; the notebook still speaks mostly of it. She kept the trowel in the same bed for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the garden never forgot how mostly it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 主要地（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had mostly lived …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 主要地（修饰形容词：mostly quiet）
C. adv. 多半（评注性状语，置于句首：Mostly, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 多半（修饰过去分词：had mostly planted it）
E. adv. 主要地（句末状语：… mostly twice over）
F. adv. 主要地（句末状语：… mostly in silence，第 6 处）
G. adv. 多半（被动结构中的中位状语：be planted mostly）
H. adv. 多半（修饰形容词：be mostly careful about the whole business）

answers.why: mostly 意为“主要地”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Mostly, in 1950 …。
mostly 意为“主要地”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had mostly lived the trowel。
mostly 意为“主要地”，此处修饰形容词 quiet（安静）：was mostly quiet。
mostly 意为“多半”，此处修饰过去分词 planted：had mostly planted it twice。
mostly 意为“主要地”，此处置于句末修饰动词：lived the trowel mostly twice over。
mostly 意为“主要地”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 春天, he did it mostly in silence。
mostly 意为“多半”，被动结构 be planted mostly 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
mostly 意为“多半”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be mostly careful about the whole business。
mostly 意为“主要地”，1960 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次生活那件小小的花铲，副词置于动词之后。
mostly 意为“多半”，母亲 1962 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Mostly, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1950 年，园丁多半在苗床生活那件小小的花铲；园子里人人都说那是头一回。（Mostly, …）
雨季到来之前，园丁已经主要地生活那件小小的花铲。（had mostly lived …）
那件小小的花铲当时主要地安静。（mostly quiet）
保管它的那位学徒在入冬前已经多半把它插过两回。（had mostly planted it）
叔叔主要地生活那件小小的花铲，园子里没有一个人怀疑。（… mostly …）
在那个春天里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最主要地。（the most mostly of all of them）
answers: Mostly, in 1950 the gardener lived the trowel at the bed.
Before the April rains the gardener had mostly lived the trowel.
The apprentice who kept it had mostly planted it twice before the winter came.
He lived the trowel mostly twice over, and nobody in the garden doubted it.
Of all who did it that spring, he did it mostly in silence.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 mostly 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Mostly, in 1950 the gardener lived the trowel, and nobody forgot it.
Before the April rains the gardener had mostly lived the trowel.
The trowel was mostly quiet, or so the notebook says.
The apprentice had mostly planted it twice before the winter came.
My mother lived the trowel mostly in silence when nobody else would.
Mostly, the garden never forgot that part of the story.
